economic_hypothesis: A stale annual resistance breakout is more credible when price has approached and tested the old supply zone through an orderly, low-damage absorption process before the breakout. A one-day jump after a loose or overextended approach is not equivalent to prior supply absorption.
pre_signal_feature_clock: all features end at the last completed daily bar strictly before the breakout signal close

feature_dictionary.near_resistance_close_share_20: share of the prior 20 completed closes in [0.90R, R), where R is the frozen stale prior-250-session peak
feature_dictionary.near_resistance_touch_count_60: count in the prior 60 completed sessions with high >= 0.97R and close < R
feature_dictionary.approach_path_efficiency_20: positive-coordinate displacement over sum of absolute close-to-close moves during the prior 20 completed sessions
feature_dictionary.prebreakout_runup_20: last prior completed close / first close in the prior-20 window - 1
feature_dictionary.prebreakout_max_drawdown_20: minimum prior close / running prior close maximum - 1 within the prior-20 window
feature_dictionary.prior5_turnover_over_prior20: mean turnover in the last 5 completed pre-signal sessions divided by mean turnover in the prior-20 window

rule_space.selection_primary: highest median annual mean net return across 2014-2018
rule_space.selection_secondary: highest worst annual mean net return
